name: three minute demo
comment: Fixed sequence for the stage. SPEC.md section 14 beats: the opener, the deliberate wrong finger, a break, the retry, then the last one. It is played inside the node the showcase opens, u2-l1 Hello eight, pairs 6x8 8x6 7x8, five questions. So the five that play are the node's own two facts, plus 6x6 as the one review from outside a node is allowed, and step five is the node's other orientation of 6x8, a pose the child has not held yet. The sixth step is reached only by a client with no node, which fixes no length.
